h1: Ebb & Flow | Luxe Beach Access Hot Tub Guest Suite
meta_description: Book Ebb & Flow | Luxe Beach Access Hot Tub Guest Suite directly on LocalVR for the best rates. No third-party fees. Welcome to Ebb & Flow — a newly built, designer-crafted coastal retreat in the heart of FL
description_expanded: SummaryWelcome to Ebb & Flow — a newly built, designer-crafted coastal retreat in the heart of FL's iconic 30A, tucked between Alys Beach and Big Chill. Nestled in the serene Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community, this luxury beach house offers rare, deeded beach access, a treetop hot tub, and a separate Private Guest Suite — ideal for multi-family vacations, wellness retreats, or remote work escapes. Discover a light-filled, open-concept floor plan with luxury finishes and curated designer touches.SpaceWHAT YOU’LL LOVE - Deeded beach access (4-min walk) + public beach access 2 minutes further with showers - Hot tub for 5 on upper deck with forest views and heated community pool just steps away - Brand-new construction with luxury furnishings & designer finishes - 6 bedrooms & 6.5 baths, including Private Guest Suite with its own entrance, kitchenette, and fitness area - 5 hybrid bikes, 6 beach chairs, umbrellas, wagons & beach games - Dedicated workspace with 1GB Wi-Fi, monitor & printer - Two full-size laundry towers for added convenience - EV charger (level 2) available free to guests- (property has 220V available, all EV chargers are proprietary so every brand is different) MAIN LIVING AREA - Spacious living room with soaring ceilings, Italian tile, fireplace, 65” Smart TV, and surround sound system - European kitchen and wet bar, featuring Bosch & Café appliances to complement fully stocked chef’s kitchen - Indoor dining for 10, island seating for 4, and outdoor dining for 6 in an expansive screened porch BEDROOM LAYOUT: MAIN HOUSE: All bedrooms offer ensuite baths, vaulted ceilings, Smart TVs, modern furnishings, and access to shared decks upstairs. - 1 King Suite on the main level & private outdoor shower - 2 King Suites upstairs (one with a 2nd private outdoor shower) - 1 Queen Bedroom - 1 Bedroom with 2 Double Beds LOWER-LEVEL SEPARATE GUEST SUITE: Additional “CASITA” with own entrance. Perfect for grandparents, nannies, or remote work privacy. Includes: - Queen Bedroom, kitchenette & full bath - Fitness space including treadmill, bike, weights & bench EXTRA TOUCHES - Rinse-off outdoor showers at entries (main house + guest suite) - Screened porch with dining for 6, plus lounge seating for 5 - Outdoor Grill - Beach towels, bath linens, and starter essentials provided - Parking spots for 2 vehicles, one covered (car port) and one uncovered. PRIME 30A LOCATION - Quiet, tree-lined neighborhood with easy biking to local spots - 1.5 mi to Alys Beach, 2.1 mi to Rosemary Beach - 1.6 mi to The Big Chill for dining & live music Ebb & Flow offers a rare combination of location, privacy, design, and luxury in one of 30A’s newest elegant retreats!NeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a quiet, tree-lined community ideally situated along Scenic Highway 30A. Guests can bike to nearby Alys Beach, explore boutique shops in Rosemary Beach, or catch live music at The Big Chill. The area offers easy access to dining, paddleboarding, coastal dune lakes, and white-sand beachesTransitNo car is required to enjoy nearby beach access, but highly recommend a vehicle for exploring 30A’s full stretch. Five hybrid bikes are included for easy rides to The Big Chill and beyond.AccessGuests have access to the entire home including the guest suite, hot tub, screened porch, grill, bikes, and 2 private parking spaces. The guest suite has its own entrance for added privacy.NotesLike many homes in 30A, this home is equipped with A/C but may take time to cool after guest arrival. We recommend keeping doors closed for optimal performance. Quiet hours are observed in the Magnolia Cottages neighborhood from 9 p.m. to 7 a.m. to maintain the relaxing atmosphere for all guests. Golf cart rentals are allowed in the community but must be parked in designated areas. No trailers or RVs are permitted on site.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted.Read Less
